name: LibriSpeech
description: Corpus of approximately 1,000 hours of 16 kHz read English speech derived from audiobooks in the LibriVox project, designed for automatic speech recognition research.
citation: Panayotov, V., Chen, G., Povey, D., & Khudanpur, S. (2015). Librispeech: An ASR corpus based on public domain audio books. 2015 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP), 5206–5210. https://doi.org/10.1109/ICASSP.2015.7178964

license.identifier: Public domain audio; no standard SPDX identifier for the dataset as a whole
license.notes: The corpus is sourced from LibriVox public-domain audiobooks. This dataset-level public-domain status is not a standard SPDX license identifier; verify rights and terms for the specific recordings and metadata before redistribution or use.
